params.name: Naming Convention
params.tooltip:
How Auto Line Namer builds line names.
Custom uses the convention in auto_line_namer/aln_config.lua.

params.name: Town Names
params.tooltip: Short uses the first three letters of each word (Springfield -> Spr).

params.name: Stop Names
params.tooltip:
What the line is named after.
Towns: the towns it connects.
Stations: its stations' names.
Industries: the industry each stop serves, or the station name where it serves none.
Short/Full from Town Names applies to all three.

params.name: Cargo Names
params.tooltip: How cargo is written in line names. Short uses the first three letters of each word; Code uses a fixed 3-letter code. Individual cargo can be overridden in the advanced settings below.

params.name: Auto Update
params.tooltip:
How often ALL lines are re-checked and renamed, including existing lines and lines you renamed yourself (unless their name starts with Cst).
Off: only new lines (and lines you rename to r or reload) get an auto name; your own names are never changed.

params.name: Line Number Digits
params.tooltip: How many digits {lineNumber} uses, padded with zeros: 1 gives 1, 2, 3; 3 gives 001, 002, 003.

params.name: Transport Labels
params.tooltip: Short: Bus, RC, TP, TC, HE. Long: Road - Bus, Road - Truck, Rail, Air - Helicopter and so on. Labels you changed in aln_config.lua are kept either way.

params.name: Cargo Stop Names
params.tooltip: What cargo lines are named after. Same as Stop Names, or Towns, Stations or Industries for cargo lines only, e.g. towns for passenger lines and industries for cargo.

params.name: Cargo Lines Show
params.tooltip: First and last stop (e.g. Mine-Steel Mill), or only the delivery stop, the line's last stop (e.g. Steel Mill).

params.name: Advanced settings (optional)
params.tooltip: Per-cargo name overrides. Optional; leave them on Default to ignore them.
values: Cargo name overrides below, can be ignored
